question: Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) is an electronic platform for facilitating the financing/discounting of trade receivables of which sector?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**MSME sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS)** is an institutional mechanism set up in India to facilitate the **financing of trade receivables**, specifically for the **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector**.
